subject: Trial runway rescue: dependency freeze impacting demo window
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:02:00Z
Subject: Trial runway rescue: dependency freeze impacting demo window

Hey Ben / Kim,

Quick ask — ClearFin (trial) hit a hard dependency freeze on their third-party account-sync adapter during their pre-demo run. Engineering on their side says it will take ~10 business days to land a patch (they're blocked by an external vendor). This blocks their scheduled demo next month and stalls our evaluation.

Why this matters:
- ACV on track: ~$85k ARR (pilot -> paid if demo goes well)
- Current sandbox usage nearing limit; customer team needs more tokens to keep running end-to-end tests once the adapter is patched
- Competitive timeline: they’re evaluating another provider and the delay is the main risk

Ask: approval to grant a 30-day trial extension + $5,000 sandbox credit to keep their momentum. I can include engineering notes and the onboarding plan. If approved, I’ll:
- Notify ClearFin and align new demo date
- Add a conditional clause to the extension (one-time, tied to A) proof of progress from their vendor or B) internal engineering sign-off)

Attachments: saml-trace-20270418.txt (failure logs), onboarding-plan-clearfin-v2.pdf (updated timeline)

Thanks — I think this is high-leverage to preserve the deal.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T17:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Trial runway rescue: dependency freeze impacting demo window

Thanks for the context, Soojin — good summary. A couple quick clarifying questions before I greenlight:

1) Can you confirm the likelihood of the external vendor delivering in the 10 business day window? Any written ETA from their side?
2) Do we have a clear milestone we can tie the credit/extension to (e.g., successful end-to-end sync test)?
3) If the deal doesn't progress after extension, do we have a path to reclaim or mark the promo as used?

If Kimberly can confirm the technical risk and milestone, I'm inclined to approve the 30-day extension + $5k sandbox credit, but want the conditional clause documented (we'll track in HubSpot).

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:31:00Z
Subject: Re: Trial runway rescue: dependency freeze impacting demo window

On Apr 18, 2027, at 17:08, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the context, Soojin — good summary. A couple quick clarifying questions before I greenlight:

Confirming technical details:
- The logs Soojin attached show repeated OAuth handshakes failing with a ScopedToken mismatch — not a Redwood SDK bug.
- ClearFin's engineers have a vendor ticket (Ticket #VND-7741) and quoted an ETA of ~7–12 business days for a fix; they've shared incremental updates via the ticket.
- Kimberly's suggested milestone: an end-to-end sync test (creating a synthetic account + successful webhook acknowledgement) performed in the ClearFin sandbox environment.

Risk mitigation & operational notes:
- Granting $5k sandbox credit covers their immediate test cycles without a broader promo exposure.
- We can set the credit to auto-expire if the milestone isn't met within the 30-day window.
- Engineering (CS) will request a daily brief on progress for the first week after approval.

From a CS/tech standpoint I support the extension on the conditions above.

— Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Mills <jordan@clearfin.io>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:17:00Z
Subject: Re: Trial runway rescue: dependency freeze impacting demo window

Looping Jordan in — we have internal alignment to proceed conditionally. Final terms:
- 30-day trial extension starting 2027-04-21
- $5,000 sandbox credit applied to their trial account (auto-expire if no milestone)
- Milestone: successful end-to-end sync test (synthetic account + webhook ack)
- Reporting cadence: daily brief from ClearFin engineering for first 7 days, then every 3 days until milestone

Jordan — can you confirm you accept these terms and that you'll share the vendor ticket updates with our CS team? Once you reply, I'll push the promo and update HubSpot (deal CLF-2027-058).

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Jordan Mills <jordan@clearfin.io>
> Thanks, Soojin — appreciate the rapid response and the flexibility. We'll share the vendor ticket and the first test report by EOD tomorrow.

— Soojin
